ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
overview: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) is a government initiative aimed at providing affordable housing to all eligible citizens by 2024. It has two components: PMAY-Urban (PMAY-U) for urban beneficiaries and PMAY-Gramin (PMAY-G) for rural beneficiaries. The scheme provides financial assistance to construct or buy a house. Under PMAY-U, beneficiaries receive an interest subsidy on home loans (Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme - CLSS), or a central grant of ₹1.5 lakh for in-situ slum redevelopment and affordable housing. Under PMAY-G, rural beneficiaries receive ₹1.20 lakh (plains) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/North East/tribal areas) as housing grant.
key_facts: PMAY-Gramin grant: ₹1.20 lakh in plains, ₹1.30 lakh in hilly/NE/tribal regions
PMAY-Urban CLSS: Interest subsidy of up to 6.5% on home loans for EWS/LIG, 4% for MIG-I, 3% for MIG-II
Beneficiary must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Administered by: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (Urban) and Ministry of Rural Development (Rural)

eligibility.description: Eligibility differs for urban and rural components and income groups.

rules.description: Applicant or any family member must not own a pucca house anywhere in India

income_categories.EWS: Economically Weaker Section — Annual income up to ₹3 lakh
income_categories.LIG: Low Income Group — Annual income ₹3 lakh to ₹6 lakh
income_categories.MIG-I: Middle Income Group I — Annual income ₹6 lakh to ₹12 lakh
income_categories.MIG-II: Middle Income Group II — Annual income ₹12 lakh to ₹18 lakh

documents: Aadhaar card (mandatory for all family members)
Proof of residence (voter ID, ration card)
For CLSS: Loan sanction letter from bank
application_steps: Step 1: Visit pmaymis.gov.in (Urban) or your Gram Panchayat (Rural)
Step 2: For Urban — click 'Citizen Assessment' and select your category
Step 3: Enter your Aadhaar number for verification
Step 4: Fill in family, income, and housing details
Step 5: Submit the application — a unique Application ID will be generated
Step 6: For CLSS, approach an empanelled Primary Lending Institution (PLI) bank
Step 7: Track application status at pmaymis.gov.in using your Application ID

faqs.question: What is the difference between PMAY-Urban and PMAY-Gramin?
faqs.answer: PMAY-Urban is for people living in urban areas and provides interest subsidy on home loans (CLSS) or direct grants. PMAY-Gramin (PMAY-G) is for rural areas and provides a direct cash grant of ₹1.20-1.30 lakh to construct a house.

faqs.question: Can I apply if I already have a house?
faqs.answer: No. If you or any member of your family owns a pucca house anywhere in India, you are not eligible for PMAY.

faqs.question: How much interest subsidy will I get?
faqs.answer: EWS/LIG: 6.5% subsidy on loans up to ₹6 lakh. MIG-I: 4% on loans up to ₹9 lakh. MIG-II: 3% on loans up to ₹12 lakh.
